metadata.description: A collection of custom Agent Skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: stacked-prs
plugins.description: Manage stacked PR branches - split large changes into small, reviewable PRs, update branches after base merge, and cascade changes downstream.

plugins.name: session-retrospective
plugins.description: Run a structured Keep/Problem/Try retrospective at session end, cross-reference past retrospectives for recurring patterns, then propose memory entries, doc updates, and skill candidates.

plugins.name: japanese-tech-writing
plugins.description: 日本語の技術文書・書籍原稿の文章規範（整形・パラグラフライティング・論証の厳密さ・冗長の排除など）。日本語で技術書や記事を書く/推敲するときに使用。Derived from k16shikano's gist (used with permission).
